# A book with everything a printed invoice puts on the page.
#
# The other print fixtures are sparse — a customer with no address, no company
# block — so the page they draw is a grid of totals with empty boxes around
# it, and a test reading that page cannot tell a missing address from a
# stylesheet that never applied. This one carries what a real document
# carries: a seller with an address and registration numbers, a customer with
# an address, a posted invoice with a described line, and dates written the
# book's way — and a vendor with a posted bill, the other document a book
# prints.
#
# Every name, number and address here is invented.

2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100

2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Accounts Payable
	type: Accounts Payable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Office Supplies
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

company
	name: "Example Widgets Inc."
	addr[0]: "500-1 Example Avenue"
	addr[1]: "Springfield ON"
	addr[2]: "Canada"
	addr[3]: "A1A 1A1"
	id: "000000000"
	gst: "000000000 RT 0001"
	contact: "A Person"
	date_format: "%Y-%m-%d"

customer "C-WHOLE"
	name: "Second Example Ltd"
	currency: CAD
	addr[0]: "Second Example Ltd"
	addr[1]: "2 Example Street, Suite 100"
	addr[2]: "Registration Number: 0000000"
	addr[3]: "Othertown ON B2B 2B2"

invoice "INV-WHOLE-001"
	customer_id: "C-WHOLE"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-07-31
	notes: "Net 30. Quoted 2026-07-01."
	entry:
		date: 2026-07-31
		description: "Monthly service for July 2026 | Account 00000 | Unit 0000"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 40
		price: 68
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-07-31
		due: 2026-09-30
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "INV-WHOLE-001"
		accumulate: true

# A bill as well, because a document's styling is set on the book and applies
# to both — and one of two near-identical print paths is where a setting that
# reaches only invoices would hide.
vendor "V-WHOLE"
	name: "Third Example Supply Co."
	currency: CAD
	addr[0]: "Third Example Supply Co."
	addr[1]: "3 Example Road"
	addr[2]: "Elsewhere ON"
	addr[3]: "C3C 3C3"

bill "BILL-WHOLE-001"
	vendor_id: "V-WHOLE"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-07-15
	notes: "Account 00000."
	entry:
		date: 2026-07-15
		description: "Paper, letter, 5000 sheets"
		action: "Material"
		account: "Expenses:Office Supplies"
		quantity: 10
		price: 12.5
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-07-15
		due: 2026-08-14
		ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable"
		memo: "BILL-WHOLE-001"
		accumulate: true
